business_problem: ADNOC describes using autonomous well control to improve safe operations and efficiency in response to changing well conditions, while reducing travel, physical interventions, and emissions.
solution_summary: ADNOC deployed RoboWell, an AIQ-developed autonomous well-control solution, at the offshore NASR field, initially across 10 wells. The source describes cloud-based AI algorithms that respond to changing well conditions and autonomously operate wells, with operations self-adjusting as conditions change. This is the only stated processing-to-control pattern; the page does not name sensor inputs, ingestion interfaces, model design, a cloud provider, storage services, or a control-system integration. AIQ partnered with ADNOC on deployment, and ADNOC's Thamama Excellence Center was involved in developing RoboWell; the source describes that center as using big data, digitalization, and smart analytics, but does not identify those as NASR runtime components. The stated deployment is field-level, with an initial 10 wells and planned expansion to over 300 wells across ADNOC's offshore and onshore operations; no downstream data consumer is identified.

solution_components.name: RoboWell
solution_components.role: Uses cloud-based AI algorithms to autonomously operate wells and adjust operation to changing conditions.

data_flow: Changing well conditions inform RoboWell's cloud-based AI algorithms, which autonomously adjust well operation. The page does not identify the sensors, data transport, storage, or control interfaces.
business_outcome: RoboWell is described as enhancing safe well operation and efficiency, reducing travel and physical interventions, and minimizing emissions. AIQ said the solution had previously been proven to deliver up to 30% optimization in gas lift consumption and up to 5% increase in operating efficiency; these figures are not explicitly attributed to the NASR deployment.

evidence_quotes: RoboWell uses cloud-based AI algorithms to autonomously operate wells that self-adjust according to changing conditions.
RoboWell has already been proven to deliver up to 30% optimization in gas lift consumption and up to 5% increase in operating efficiency.
RoboWell has been deployed across an initial 10 wells at NASR, with further deployment ... at over 300 wells across ADNOC’s offshore and onshore operations.
This enhances the safe operation of the well, improves efficiency, reduces the need for travel and physical interventions, and so minimizes emissions.
